formation: Depicts a line (囱) piercing a heart (心) (i.e. having an insightful understanding), conveying the meaning "insightful", now written as 聰. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.

components.note: In ancient China, it was thought that the heart was the center of thought and reasoning.
Depicts a line piercing. Represents having an insightful understanding in one's thoughts.
